page.layout: One page of text: a heading across the top, then one column of year-and-name entries with ruled separators between groups. Catchword at the lower right. Page number top left.

main_text.head: Curatores ordinarij quaterni, bini oppidani, bini agrarij.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (Gosuuinus, Postanus). "Edzard Iacob Clant." carries a small mark after the full stop that may be a stray reference or print flaw; not reproduced. Catchword "Abel" at lower right. Faint stamp-like marks at lower left and a digitiser watermark at lower right were left out.
